main_text.p: Frustra conatus sine re] Parturiunt montes, nascetur ridiculus mus.
Frustulum] Frustillum, Sipont. Massula salis, Col. Buccella. Ofella carnis, Mart. Offula, Varr.
Fruftum] Fragmentum, Cic. Fragmen. Massa ferri. Offa panis, Col. Cruftum (panis) Virg. Quadra panis, Sen. Raudus & Rodus plumbi, Serv.
Fruticare] Fruticari. Propagari : vera gloria radices agit & propagatur, Cic. Fruticescere. Pullulare. Proserpit herba. Plin. Pullulascere, Col. Congerminare, Gell.
Fucare] Fuco circumlinire, Lucr. Ad placendum fuco aliquid subornatur, Sen. Nitorem cuti inducere, Plin. Mentiri colorem fuco, Virg. Fuco splendente genas ornare, Tibul.
Fucatus] Fuco illitus. Coloratus. Fucosæ merces. Infucata vina, Cic. Infincerus cruor, Virg.
Fucus] Pigmentum. Offucia, Plaut. Tentipellium, Titin. Tectorium, Iuv. Medicamentum faciei, Sen.
Fucus rebus detergendus] Nunquam mihi Mango, Medicus; nunquam muscerda, piper erit.
Fuga]Fugela, Apul. Præsidium fugæ, Amm. Effugium. Cic.

Fugare] Vertere, agere in fugam aliquem. Avertere in fugam hostes, Liv. Facere fugam alicui Plaut. Retroagere aliquem. Retro ire cogere, Plin. Dispalare milites, Sisen. Dispergere, Sil. Dissipare, Cæs. Injicere fugam alicui, Plaut.
Fugax] Fugacissimus, Sen. Lepore, Parthis fugacior, Er.

Fugere]Fugere è manibus. In fugam se conferre, conjicere, Cic. Fugam capessere, Liv. Dimissis manibus fugere, Plaut. Conscisccre sibi fugam, Tac. Conjicere se in pedes. Penetrare se in fugam, Plaut. Ab inermibus pedibus auxilium petere, Salust. Effundi in fugam. Terga dare, vertere, Liv. Mandare se fugæ. Exsequi fugam, Cic. Occipitium & armos ostendere, Prop. Fuga salutem petere, Cæs. Ambobus pedibus fugere. Fugere utroque velo. Apparare fugam. Maturare fugam.

page.notes: Catchword "Fugere" printed at lower right. Some words in the first lines are faint; the Greek-free entries were read from the scan with minor uncertainty in "Fruftum" and "Fucus", transcribed as printed.
